item.title: Oswego High School teacher becomes Grammy Music Educator Award top 10 finalist for 2nd time
item.description: "I get way more satisfaction of my students having success than I do of my own," said Oswego High School Band, Jazz, and Orchestra Programs Director Kevin Schoenbach.

item.title: Kids take the ice at Millennium Park, ABC7's Greg Dutra serves as hockey coach
item.description: Inner city-youth learned figure skating and hockey on Sunday, with coaching from ABC7 Meteorologist Greg Dutra. About a dozen kids and adults hit the ice at Millennium Park in downtown Chicago.

item.title: Pedestrian struck, several injured in multi-vehicle crash on Edens Expy. in Skokie, ISP says
item.description: A pedestrian was struck and several people were injured in a multi-vehicle crash on the Edens Expressway on Sunday morning, according to Illinois State Police.

item.title: $500K fundraised for Lurie Children's at 'AON Step Up for Kids'
item.description: One step at a time, thousands of people made a difference by climbing up 80 floors of Chicago's AON Center.

item.title: Grammys 2026: See photos and fashion looks from music's biggest night
item.description: Take a look at all the red carpet looks as the stars kick off the 68th Grammy Awards.

item.title: Kennedy Center to close for 2 years for renovations in July, Pres. Trump says
item.description: President Donald Trump said Sunday he will move to close Washington's Kennedy Center performing arts venue for two years starting in July for construction.

item.title: Water main break impacting more than half of Dixmoor residents, village president says
item.description: A water main break in Dixmoor is impacting more than half of the south suburban community on Sunday, officials said.

item.title: Work requirements impacting SNAP eligibility takes effect, worrying Illinois recipients, food banks
item.description: Before now, Illinois had a work requirement waiver for what the law defines as able-bodied adults who applied for SNAP benefits. As of Sunday, that's gone, threatening the ability of hundreds of thousands across the state to put food on the table.

item.title: Bad Bunny makes Grammys history with first Spanish-language win for album of the year
item.description: Bad Bunny won album of the year at the 2026 Grammy Awards, closing out a surprising and history-making night. Here are the highlights.

item.title: Music's biggest stars use the Grammys stage to protest Trump's immigration crackdown
item.description: Pushback against from music's biggest stars was visible Sunday from the Grammys red carpet and throughout the telecast, including a memorable speech from Bad Bunny.
